test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'HERO' is written as 'IGSQ' and 'LOVE' is written as ‘MQWG’. How will 'ROAD' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'HERO' is written as 'IGSQ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/285bdb9d8abe24239ca6baa8ab04453753a4c90bf4a55d4cb59b037ae94e58a2.png] 

For, 'LOVE' is written as ‘MQWG’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c3f515acab2c01a13f266ddc56ee845492633e800002eeb257e43c01ea99d7b.png] 

Similarly, for ROAD:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c19f020ea96c5ae395cda3ae397bd9120887214777e8a2a20c33f4afdff80b6.png] 

So, 'ROAD' will be written as 'SQBF'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
